seo.featuresSubtitle: AI contract review that scans every clause for hidden risks, missing protections, and unfair terms — explained in plain language you can act on.
seo.reviewFeature1Desc: AI scans every clause for hidden risks, missing protections, and unfair terms.
seo.reviewFeature2Desc: Auto-detects governing law and applies the right legal framework (US, EU, UK, China, etc.)
seo.reviewFeature3Desc: Get ready-to-use scripts: what to say, how to counter, what to compromise on.
seo.reviewFeature4Desc: No legal jargon. We explain every clause in language you understand.
seo.reviewFeature5Desc: Upload a contract and get a full report in under a minute.
seo.reviewFeature6Desc: Your contract files are processed in memory only — never stored on our servers.
seo.compareFeature1Desc: AI compares two contract versions and highlights every modification, addition, and deletion.
seo.compareFeature2Desc: Catches "word games" — when wording changes but meaning stays unfavorable.
seo.compareFeature3Desc: Each change is labeled: improved, worsened, or unchanged for you.
seo.compareFeature4Desc: See old text vs new text in a clean, organized layout.
seo.scenariosSubtitle: From freelance agreements to investment deals — SpotClause helps you review contracts across every industry and jurisdiction.
seo.scenario1Desc: Verify payment terms, IP ownership, and termination rights before signing client contracts.
seo.scenario2Desc: Check non-compete clauses, working hours, and probation periods for compliance with labor law.
seo.scenario3Desc: Avoid overly broad confidentiality scope, perpetual obligations, and one-sided terms.
seo.scenario4Desc: Understand data ownership, SLA terms, and liability limits for technology contracts.
seo.scenario5Desc: Review rent escalation clauses, repair responsibilities, and deposit terms.
seo.scenario6Desc: Catch unfavorable valuation adjustments, liquidation preferences, and control terms.
seo.howitSubtitle: Upload any contract, get a full risk report with negotiation tips in under 60 seconds. No legal background needed.
seo.step1Desc: Drag and drop your PDF, Word, or image file (up to 20MB).
seo.step2Desc: Our AI parses every clause, matches risk rules, and assesses fairness.
seo.step3Desc: Risk score, clause-by-clause analysis, and contract insights in plain English.
seo.faqSubtitle: Learn how SpotClause keeps your data safe, what contracts we support, and how our AI delivers accurate results.
seo.faq1A: Yes. Contract files are processed in memory and never saved to our servers. Only the analysis report is stored in your account.
seo.faq2Q: What languages and regions are supported?
seo.faq2A: We support 14+ languages and auto-detect the contract jurisdiction (US, EU, UK, China, Japan, and more) to apply the right legal context.
seo.faq3Q: How accurate is the AI analysis?
seo.faq3A: Our AI uses a curated rule library to highlight patterns in contracts. However, it is an informational tool only and not a substitute for a qualified attorney for high-stakes deals.
seo.faq4Q: Can I try it for free?
seo.faq4A: Yes — every account gets one free contract review (1MB file size limit). Paid plans start at $12.90/month for 10 reviews.
